rules.name: AI — Direct Prompt Injection
rules.description: Detects direct prompt injection attempts overriding system instructions via user input
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "direct" or Message contains "prompt" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-AI-PI-001

rules.name: AI — Indirect Prompt Injection via External Data
rules.description: Detects prompt injection payloads embedded in uploaded files, web pages, or external data sources
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "indirect" or Message contains "prompt" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-AI-PI-002

rules.name: AI — System Prompt Extraction Attempt
rules.description: Detects attempts to extract system prompts through direct questioning, translation, or format manipulation
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'prompt_extraction' | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), resource_group | where count_ > 5

rules.name: AI — Jailbreak via Role-Play Persona
rules.description: Detects jailbreak attempts using role-play personas like DAN, developer mode, or unrestricted AI
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'jailbreak' | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), resource_group | where count_ > 5

rules.name: AI — Prompt Injection via Few-Shot Manipulation
rules.description: Detects few-shot learning manipulation attacks that inject malicious examples into LLM context
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "prompt" or Message contains "injection" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-AI-PI-005

rules.name: AI — Data Exfiltration via Model Output
rules.description: Detects LLM outputs containing PII, training data, or confidential information indicating data leakage
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'data_exfiltration' | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), resource_group | where count_ > 5

rules.name: AI — Training Data Extraction Attack
rules.description: Detects attempts to extract training data from LLM through targeted queries and completions
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'data_extraction' | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), resource_group | where count_ > 5

rules.name: AI — PII Leakage via LLM Response
rules.description: Detects PII (SSN, email, phone, address) leaking through LLM responses
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'pii_leakage' | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), resource_group | where count_ > 5

rules.name: AI — Model Poisoning via Training Data Manipulation
rules.description: Detects indicators of model poisoning through anomalous training data or unexpected model behavior
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'model_poisoning' | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), resource_group | where count_ > 5

rules.name: AI — Backdoor Trigger Detection in LLM Output
rules.description: Detects potential backdoor triggers in LLM output patterns that indicate compromised models
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'backdoor' | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), resource_group | where count_ > 5

rules.name: AI — RAG Pipeline Data Poisoning

rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "rag" or Message contains "pipeline" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-AI-RAG-001

rules.name: AI — RAG Retrieval Manipulation via Adversarial Documents
rules.description: Detects adversarial documents in RAG stores designed to manipulate retrieval results
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "rag" or Message contains "retrieval" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-AI-RAG-002

rules.name: AI — Hallucination Detection — Fabricated Entity References
rules.description: Detects LLM responses containing fabricated URLs, citations, or entity references indicating hallucination
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "hallucination" or Message contains "fabricated" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-AI-HAL-001

rules.name: AI — Hallucination — Inconsistent Factual Claims
rules.description: Detects LLM outputs making contradictory factual claims across conversation turns
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "hallucination" or Message contains "inconsistent" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-AI-HAL-002

rules.name: AI — Bias Detection — Demographic Disparities
rules.description: Detects demographic bias patterns in LLM outputs including gender, racial, or ethnic disparities
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'bias' | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), resource_group | where count_ > 5

rules.name: AI — Governance — Missing Risk Assessment

rules.query: AuditLogs | where OperationName contains "governance" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), InitiatedBy | where count_ > 5 // AZ-AI-GOV-001

rules.name: AI — Governance — High-Risk System Without Human Oversight
rules.description: Detects high-risk AI system operations without required human oversight mechanisms per EU AI Act Article 14
rules.query: AuditLogs | where OperationName contains "governance" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), InitiatedBy | where count_ > 5 // AZ-AI-GOV-002

rules.name: AI — Governance — Missing Transparency Requirements

rules.query: AuditLogs | where OperationName contains "governance" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), InitiatedBy | where count_ > 5 // AZ-AI-GOV-003
